newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazilian paper stocks started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazilian paper stocks started.

text.p: -- ING Barings said it has started coverage of five Brazilian pulp and paper stocks.
-- In a Jan 6 report, analyst Paulo Vasconcellos said Brazilian pulp and paper stocks should increase in 1997 in anticipation of a strong earnings growth forecast for 1998.
-- Vasconcellos rated Aracruz Celulose SA, Bahia Sul Celulose SA and Klabin Papel e Celulose SA as buys.

-- Klabin was "the best vehicle for investors to participate in Brazil's economic growth," Vasconcellos wrote. "With domestic sales at 80 percent of total revenues, the company is expanding into Mercosur and plans to build a new manufacturing plant in Argentina."
-- He rated Ripasa and Companhia Suzano de Papel e Celulose SA as sells.

"Suzano may not have sufficient financial strength to support its minority interests in Brazilian petrochemical companies, diversify as planned into Brazilian telecoms and solve Bahia Sul's debt problems."
